{{Top}}
{{Quote|A few chambers did have some examples of alien artwork&mdash;notably some flatsculps from Breta Yaga and a dancer-sculp from Galloa II&mdash;although they were not as prominently displayed as the other artwork.|Voren Na'al|<ref name="Field Report">{{WEGCite|story=Field Report|book=The Last Command Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
'''Flatsculp''' or '''flatsculpt''' was a two-dimension form of art popularized by the [[Vaathkree (species)|Vaathkree]].<ref name="HE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>

[[Oordo III]] was made famous by its flatsculps.<ref name="3se">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>

The flatsculp "[[Stars and Moons]]" was originally owned by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Ammar]] until it was stolen by [[Cunbus Locb]] around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="ss">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>

The lobby of the [[Bakur Memorial Building]] on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] was decorated with flatsculps and other works of art by native [[Bakuran]] [[Artist/Legends|artists]].
